frontmatter_snapshot.summary: OOS signal validation for CB-arb factor models partitions data into train / validation / test, rotates K-fold cross-validation to estimate generalization error, and uses the bias-variance decomposition (noise + squared bias + variance) to diagnose under- vs over-fitting. ESL Ch.7 supplies the algebra and K-fold; ISLP Ch.5 reframes at undergraduate depth.
